changes_made.explanation: Slightly clarified the output description to be more specific
Normalized ROUGE-1 to base ROUGE form as per simplification guidelines
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper
No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on natural language understanding (NLU) tasks for Swedish, with only one NLG task (text summarization) included. The paper describes Superlim, a Swedish benchmark similar to GLUE/SuperGLUE, containing 14 datasets covering 15 tasks. Only SweDN is an NLG task (summarization), evaluated with ROUGE. Most tasks are classification, inference, or similarity tasks. The paper is mainly about benchmark creation and evaluation methodology rather than NLG evaluation specifically.
